overview:
Ridgetop Research is a New York-based primary research firm founded in 2008. It serves institutional investment firms through expert consultations and surveys.

The company says dedicated analyst pods recruit experts for individual mandates across sectors worldwide. Its public offer includes a client compliance portal and call chaperoning with ACA.

history.narrative: Ridgetop Research dates its founding to 2008 and identifies Chip Emery as its founder and current CEO. BBB's business profile also records 2008 as the business start year.

timeline.event: Ridgetop Research founded; its website identifies Chip Emery as the founder.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Consultations
servicesDetailed.description: Ridgetop says its recruiting analysts source experts for each client's research mandates across sectors.

servicesDetailed.name: Surveys & Panels
servicesDetailed.description: Ridgetop describes questionnaire design, sampling, programming, and data delivery through online, telephone, and mobile channels, with Consumer, B2B, and Healthcare panels.

servicesDetailed.name: Call Chaperoning
servicesDetailed.description: Ridgetop says its ACA partnership offers two levels of call chaperoning, including observation, minutes, and risk flags, with additional attestations and disclosure checks in the second tier.

complianceExtended.narrative: Ridgetop describes a compliance workflow adapted to each client's requirements. These procedures are company-stated and have not been independently assessed here.
highlights: Client compliance portal for review workflows
ACA chaperoning with minutes and MNPI risk flags

clientFit.narrative: Ridgetop positions its custom recruiting and surveys for institutional investment firms.

strengths: Company-described client compliance workflows and chaperoning
caveats: Pricing is not disclosed on the reviewed official page.
AI expert matching and SaaS benchmarking were not substantiated by the reviewed public sources.
Current headcount and a comprehensive interaction audit trail could not be established.
notableFacts: Founded in 2008, according to the official site and BBB business profile
Company lists offices in New York and Charlotte
Company reports 350,000+ experts in its network (accessed 2026-11-11)
sourceNotes: Ridgetop Research official website — https://www.ridgetopresearch.com/ — accessed 2026-11-11. Supports the 2008 founding, New York and Charlotte offices, and company-stated network size, cross-sector recruiting pods, surveys, panels, compliance portal, consultant screening and training, and ACA chaperoning. Concierge delivery is an editorial classification based on dedicated recruiting teams; Global reflects the company's worldwide sourcing description. The page does not substantiate the former technology-only, SaaS benchmarking, AI matching, technical credential/NDA screening, pre-IPO safeguards, pricing, headcount, comprehensive audit-trail, or clean-regulatory-record claims. A search for material developments during 2025-11-11–2026-11-11 located no qualifying dated primary or reputable announcement; current offerings are undated and are not presented as recent launches.

Ridgetop Research company LinkedIn page — https://www.linkedin.com/company/ridgetop-research — accessed 2026-11-11. Corroborates 2008, New York headquarters, custom recruiting, surveys, and panels. Lists a company-size band of 11–50 while displaying 75 associated employee profiles; neither establishes current headcount, so employeeCount remains Not disclosed.

BBB business profile — https://www.bbb.org/us/ny/new-york/profile/data-analytics/ridgetop-research-llc-0121-117927/ — accessed 2026-11-11. Records a 2008 business start and incorporation, a New York address, and primary research and online surveys for institutional investment firms. BBB accreditation or ratings are not used to infer regulatory history.
